en.description: Trans Sahara Marathon is a ultramarathon. Location: Zagora, Morocco. Date: 19 March 2027 – 26 March 2027. Distances: 150 km, 4Etappen. Entry fee: check with the organiser. The map below shows the host town; check the organiser for the exact start line.
